notes.title: New Game Announcement: Turf Wars - A Snail Escape
notes.notes:
We are super-excited to announce our latest, upcoming game Turf Wars: A Snail Escape. Wishlist or try out the demo now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058360

[u][b]What is Turf Wars: A Snail Escape?
[/b][/u]Inspired by some of our favorite games such as Hades and Splatoon, in Turf Wars, you need to move from area to area, pick up upgrades and beat dangerous bosses. This is a single-player rougelike, where you got to expand your turf before the enemy does or risk being stranded without ammo. Can you make it all the way?

[b]What are you waiting for? Join the Turf Wars now![/b]

notes.title: New Freeplay Mode Available Now
notes.notes:
Think the campaign is too easy? Then it's time to put your crew to the test in Freeplay Mode, where you and your crew must try and collect all the loot on any mission you want. Do you have what it takes to collect all the loot on all 17 missions? 

[b]New Freeplay Mode[/b]
- You can attempt ANY mission you want
- Missions are still equally hard
- Captain is randomly selected before each mission

This update also includes some graphical upgrades and minor bug fixes.

notes.title: "I Am the Captain Now" Available Now
notes.notes:
This is a game to put your cooperation skills to the test, no matter if it is your family, friends or with your worst enemies. If you can't meet up with your crew mates in real life, no worry, the game is fully working online with Steam Remote Play Together. 

You need 3-4 players to get the full social experience, but there is also a slightly more difficult 2 player mode available for those who can't gather a full pirate crew. The game is available on Steam exclusively and is compatible with controllers or keyboard.

notes.title: I Am the Captain Now Launches on May 27th
notes.notes:
It's soon here! Prepare yourself to pack your sword and hook and get lost at sea. There is plenty of loot around but only room for one captain. It's is time to stop playing nice and start forming alliances, because in your crew the captain calls all the shots... until he is thrown overboard at least.

The game launches on May 27th and is fully working online with Steam Remote Play and only one copy of the game. So gather your closest friends and enemies and be ready to embark on this crazy 3-4 player adventure unlike anything you ever played before.
